title: Great rivers
info: Three great rivers shape the land: the Padma, the Jamuna, and the Meghna.
The Padma is the main branch of the Ganges in Bangladesh. The Jamuna is the main branch of the Brahmaputra.
They carry water and silt, and they join on the way to the sea.
